component.name: Casebound Audio
component.summary: Bind audio files into chaptered audiobooks and pick up where you left off

description.p: Casebound turns a folder of audio files into a single chaptered .m4b audiobook, then plays it with your place remembered — on this computer and on your other devices.

ul.li: Drop in MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG or Opus files, or a whole folder; each file becomes a chapter
Natural ordering, easy reordering, and quick chapter naming (front matter, numbered chapters, back matter)
Title, author, narrator and cover art, read from tags and editable
AAC encoding, and every finished book is verified by reading its chapters back
Continue Listening for the books you are partway through
Chapter list, playback speed that keeps the narrator's pitch, and a sleep timer
Media keys and desktop media controls

description.p: To share books and positions with other devices, choose a folder kept in sync by an app you already use, such as Nextcloud, Dropbox or Syncthing. Casebound has no account and no servers, and makes no network connections of its own.

screenshot.caption: Listen: your library, Continue Listening and the chapter list
Convert a folder of audio files into one chaptered audiobook
Built-in help, including syncing through a folder you choose

description.p: First release for Linux: convert audio files to chaptered .m4b audiobooks, a player with speed, chapters, sleep timer and resume, and position sync through a folder of your choice.
